name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi

eligibility.summary: Landholding farmer families having cultivable land in India, subject to the scheme's exclusion criteria.
important_conditions: Applicant must belong to a landholding farmer family.
The family must hold cultivable land in India.
Institutional landholders are excluded.
Certain serving or retired government employees and public office holders are excluded.
Income-tax payers are excluded.
Certain registered professionals actively practising their profession are excluded.
Non-resident Indians are excluded.

benefits: Income support of ₹6,000 per year, generally paid in three equal instalments through Direct Benefit Transfer.
application_process: Registration and beneficiary services are available through the official PM-KISAN system and authorised assisted channels.

name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana

eligibility.summary: Eligibility depends on applicable beneficiary criteria and differs for rural and urban households.
important_conditions: Eligibility is evaluated using household and socioeconomic criteria.
Rural and urban applicants are evaluated using different applicable criteria.
Final beneficiary status should be verified through the official PM-JAY eligibility system.

benefits: Provides eligible beneficiary families access to cashless secondary and tertiary hospitalisation services under PM-JAY, subject to current scheme rules.
application_process: Check beneficiary eligibility through authorised PM-JAY channels and use an eligible identity or beneficiary record at an empanelled facility.

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana

eligibility.summary: Eligible applicants seeking credit for supported micro-enterprise and income-generating business activities may apply, subject to lender and scheme requirements.
important_conditions: Applicant must be an Indian citizen.
Credit must be for an eligible business or income-generating activity.
Supported activities include various trading, service, micro-unit, transport and agriculture-allied activities.
Applicant should not be in default to a bank or financial institution.
Final sanction remains subject to lender requirements.

benefits: Provides institutional credit for eligible micro and small income-generating activities under the MUDRA framework.
application_process: Applications can be made through participating banks and other eligible lending institutions according to current PMMY procedures.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana

eligibility.summary: Eligible adult women from qualifying poor or disadvantaged households without an existing household LPG connection may qualify.
important_conditions: Applicant must be female.
Applicant must be above 18 years of age.
The household must not already have an LPG connection.
Applicant must satisfy the applicable poor-household or specified beneficiary-category requirements.

benefits: Provides eligible households support for obtaining an LPG connection under the scheme, according to current PMUY benefits.
application_process: Eligible applicants can apply through authorised LPG distributors and official PMUY channels with the required documents.

name: PM Vishwakarma

eligibility.summary: The scheme targets artisans and craftspeople working with their hands and tools in trades recognised under PM Vishwakarma, subject to current scheme eligibility requirements.
important_conditions: Applicant must work in an eligible traditional trade covered by the scheme.
Registration and verification requirements must be satisfied.
Household and previous government credit-scheme conditions may apply under current guidelines.

benefits: Eligible beneficiaries may receive recognition, skill-upgradation support, toolkit incentives, access to concessional credit and other support provided under PM Vishwakarma.
application_process: Registration is carried out through the official PM Vishwakarma process, including applicable verification stages.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana

eligibility.summary: A parent or legal guardian may open an account for an eligible girl child, subject to the scheme's age and account-limit conditions.
important_conditions: The account is opened in the name of a girl child.
The girl child must satisfy the applicable age condition at the time of opening.
The number of accounts allowed per family is subject to scheme rules.
Exceptions may apply in cases such as twins or triplets.

benefits: Provides a government-backed long-term savings option for a girl child with interest and tax treatment according to current scheme rules.
application_process: The account can be opened through eligible post offices or authorised banks with the required identity and birth-related documents.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana

eligibility.summary: Eligibility depends on the applicable PMAY component, household housing status, income category, location and current scheme guidelines.
important_conditions: The household's existing housing status is an important eligibility factor.
Urban and rural components have different eligibility criteria.
Income and beneficiary-category requirements depend on the applicable component.
Final eligibility must be checked under current PMAY guidelines.

benefits: Provides housing assistance or related financial support under applicable PMAY components, subject to current scheme rules.
application_process: Applications are made through authorised PMAY channels, local authorities or applicable government portals depending on the component.

name: Atal Pension Yojana

eligibility.summary: Eligible Indian citizens within the permitted joining age range and satisfying current scheme requirements may enrol in Atal Pension Yojana.
important_conditions: Applicant must satisfy the applicable age requirement.
Applicant must have an eligible savings bank or post-office savings account.
Contribution depends on joining age and selected pension amount.
Current tax and eligibility restrictions must be checked before enrolment.

benefits: Provides a defined pension after age 60 based on the contribution level and pension option selected under the scheme.
application_process: Eligible applicants may enrol through participating banks or post offices according to current APY procedures.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana

eligibility.summary: Eligibility depends on the applicable training programme, candidate profile, course requirements and current PMKVY guidelines.
important_conditions: Candidate must satisfy the requirements of the selected training programme.
Course-specific eligibility may vary.
Training centre and programme availability may differ by location.
Current PMKVY guidelines should be checked before enrolment.

benefits: Provides eligible candidates access to skill-development and certification opportunities under approved training programmes.
application_process: Candidates can search for eligible programmes and training centres through authorised Skill India or PMKVY channels.

name: National Scholarship Portal Schemes

eligibility.summary: Eligibility varies by the specific scholarship available through the National Scholarship Portal and may depend on course, category, income, institution and academic criteria.
important_conditions: The applicant must satisfy the requirements of the specific scholarship being applied for.
Income limits vary between scholarship schemes.
Academic and institution requirements may apply.
Application windows and document requirements differ by scheme.

benefits: Eligible students may receive scholarship support such as tuition assistance, maintenance support or other educational benefits depending on the specific scheme.
application_process: Students apply for eligible scholarship schemes through the National Scholarship Portal during the applicable application period.

name: Janani Suraksha Yojana

eligibility.summary: Pregnant women meeting applicable institutional-delivery and beneficiary conditions may qualify under the scheme.
important_conditions: Eligibility varies based on state category and applicable programme rules.
Institutional delivery is a core scheme objective.
Beneficiary conditions should be verified through the local health system.

benefits: Provides cash assistance and related support intended to encourage institutional delivery and improve maternal and neonatal health outcomes.
application_process: Eligible beneficiaries generally access the scheme through government health facilities, ASHA workers and local maternal-health services.

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi

eligibility.summary: Eligible urban street vendors satisfying the applicable identification and vending requirements may qualify.
important_conditions: Applicant must be an eligible street vendor.
Vending status or identification requirements apply.
Eligibility is subject to the current scheme guidelines and local urban-body verification.

benefits: Provides working-capital credit support and related incentives to eligible street vendors.
application_process: Applications can be made through authorised PM SVANidhi channels and participating lending institutions.

name: Stand-Up India

eligibility.summary: Eligible women and SC/ST entrepreneurs establishing qualifying greenfield enterprises may apply.
important_conditions: Applicant must satisfy the applicable women or SC/ST entrepreneur requirement.
The enterprise should satisfy greenfield-business conditions.
Business ownership and control requirements apply.
Final credit approval is subject to lender requirements.

benefits: Provides bank-credit support for eligible greenfield enterprises.
application_process: Applications are routed through participating banks and authorised Stand-Up India channels.

name: Kisan Credit Card

eligibility.summary: Eligible farmers and agricultural borrowers may access short-term credit support subject to lender and scheme conditions.
important_conditions: Applicant must satisfy eligible farming or agriculture-related criteria.
Landholding or farming-activity evidence may be required.
Credit sanction remains subject to the participating financial institution.

benefits: Provides accessible credit for agricultural and allied activities according to applicable lending rules.
application_process: Applications are made through participating banks and authorised financial institutions.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana

eligibility.summary: Eligible farmers growing notified crops in notified areas may participate subject to current insurance and enrolment rules.
important_conditions: The crop and area must satisfy the applicable notification requirements.
Enrolment must occur within the prescribed period.
Land and crop details may need verification.

benefits: Provides crop-insurance protection against specified crop losses and risks under current scheme terms.
application_process: Farmers can enrol through participating banks, authorised insurance channels and official PMFBY systems.

name: National Social Assistance Programme

eligibility.summary: Eligibility depends on the specific NSAP component and applicable socioeconomic and demographic criteria.
important_conditions: Different NSAP components serve different beneficiary groups.
Age, disability, widowhood and poverty-related requirements vary by component.
Final eligibility is determined under the relevant programme.

benefits: Provides social-assistance support through pension and related schemes for eligible vulnerable households.
application_process: Applications are processed through applicable state or local-government welfare systems.

name: Deendayal Disabled Rehabilitation Scheme

eligibility.summary: The scheme supports rehabilitation-related services for persons with disabilities through eligible implementing organisations.
important_conditions: Support is delivered through eligible organisations and approved projects.
Beneficiary access depends on the available rehabilitation services and programme conditions.

benefits: Supports rehabilitation, education, training and related services for persons with disabilities through approved projects.
application_process: Beneficiaries generally access services through organisations implementing approved rehabilitation programmes.

name: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao

eligibility.summary: This is primarily an awareness and social-development programme rather than a direct universal cash-benefit scheme.
important_conditions: The programme focuses on improving outcomes for girls.
It should not be represented as a guaranteed direct-cash benefit to every family.

benefits: Promotes the survival, protection, education and empowerment of girls through coordinated government interventions.
application_process: Participation and services vary across programme activities and local implementation.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana

eligibility.summary: Eligible pregnant women and lactating mothers satisfying current maternity-benefit conditions may qualify.
important_conditions: Pregnancy and maternity conditions apply.
Benefit eligibility depends on the current programme rules and beneficiary category.
Required maternal-health registration and documents may apply.

benefits: Provides maternity-related financial support to eligible beneficiaries under current scheme rules.
application_process: Applications are typically processed through authorised maternal-health, Anganwadi or government systems.

name: e-Shram

eligibility.summary: Eligible unorganised workers may register on the e-Shram platform subject to current registration requirements.
important_conditions: Applicant should fall within an eligible unorganised-worker category.
Current registration and identity requirements apply.
Registration itself should not be described as an automatic guarantee of every welfare benefit.

benefits: Provides a national worker-registration platform intended to support access to social-security and welfare initiatives.
application_process: Eligible workers can register through the official e-Shram system and authorised assisted channels.
